title: Uniformly bounded constructible tower
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, and use the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]: a commutative Noetherian ring $A$, an ideal $I=(a_1,\ldots,a_r)$, the rings $P_n=A/I^n$ ($n\geq1$), each finite as a set and perfect as an $A$-module, and $A/I$ torsion. On $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $R_n=(P_n)_T$ and $\widehat A_T=\varprojlim_n R_n$ (this is the sheaf denoted $A_T$ in that datum).

For a sheaf of commutative rings $R$, use $D(\operatorname{Mod}(R))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. In the tensors below $K\otimes_R^LS$ for a ring-sheaf map $R\to S$ means scalar extension computed by a K-flat resolution of a representative of $K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]; $S$ is viewed as an $R$-module by [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

An *adic tower* consists of $M_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(T))$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], together with, for each $n$, a level object $M_n\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_n))$ whose restriction of scalars to $\widehat A_T$ is identified with $\operatorname{ev}_n(M_\bullet)$, and normalization isomorphisms
$$\rho_n:M_{n+1}\otimes^L_{R_{n+1}}R_n\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n.$$
The composite of the scalar-extension map with $\rho_n$, after restriction of scalars to $\widehat A_T$, is the transition map of $M_\bullet$. The normalization isomorphisms satisfy the quotient cocycle of the coefficient datum: reduction from level $k$ to level $n$ agrees with successive reductions through any intermediate level $m$, for $k\geq m\geq n$, under the scalar-extension identifications.

It is *uniformly bounded constructible* if there are integers $d_0\leq d_1$, one finite stratification $T=\coprod_\alpha T_\alpha$ by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification], and on each stratum a pro-etale covering $\{U_{\alpha j}\to T_\alpha\}_j$, with the following data. On each $U=U_{\alpha j}$ there is a cochain complex $L_{\alpha j}$ of $\widehat A_T|_U$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with $L_{\alpha j}^q=0$ for $q\notin[d_0,d_1]$, whose terms are adic lisse of finite type [def-weil-pbc-adic-lisse-module]. For every $n$ and $q$, the cohomology sheaf
$$\mathcal H^q(L_{\alpha j}\otimes^L_{\widehat A_T|_U}R_n|_U)$$
[def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] is finite lisse: there is a pro-etale covering of $U$ on each member of which it is isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a finite $P_n$-module [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. There are $R_n|_U$-linear isomorphisms in the derived category
$$e_n:M_n|_U\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\alpha j}\otimes^L_{\widehat A_T|_U}R_n|_U.$$
Writing $N_n=L_{\alpha j}\otimes^L_{\widehat A_T|_U}R_n|_U$ and $\sigma_n:N_{n+1}\otimes^L_{R_{n+1}|_U}R_n|_U\xrightarrow{\sim}N_n$ for the quotient-reduction normalization of this local model, require
$$e_n\circ\rho_n|_U=\sigma_n\circ(e_{n+1}\otimes^L_{R_{n+1}|_U}R_n|_U).$$
All restrictions are inverse images along the stratum immersions and covering morphisms, with their restricted coefficient sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. The bounds, stratification and local complex $L_{\alpha j}$ are independent of $n$; the coverings trivializing the individual finite lisse cohomology sheaves need not be.

The local terms use the completed, adic-lisse interpretation of finite-type coefficient local systems, not finite underlying sets for integral coefficients. Stacks Tag 09BT (proetale-definition-adic, clause (3)) defines this notion for a single sheaf. Finite-level lissity and constructibility are those of Section Tag 09AI (proetale-section-constructible). The common local models, uniform termwise bounds and compatibility across the tower are additional data of this blueprint definition, not assertions of those Stacks entries.

split_report.summary: Split the definition into existing ringed-site, derived-category, K-flat tensor, cohomology, stratification and pro-etale local-constancy notions, plus one statement-only definition of adic-lisse module sheaves from Stacks 09BT(3). Corrected the missing finite-level coefficient actions and clarified the integral finite-type local terms as completed local systems, rather than finite sets. Wrote the compatibility equation and kept the single termwise window, stratification and local model. No theorem, preservation result, condensed coefficient comparison or uniform cohomological amplitude is asserted.

blueprint_update.statement:
An adic tower is an object $M_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_{A}(T))$
equipped with normalization isomorphisms
$M_{n+1}\otimes^L_{P_{n+1}}P_n\simeq M_n$ satisfying the quotient cocycle of
[def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. It is *uniformly bounded
constructible* if there are integers $d_0\leq d_1$, one finite
stratification $T=\coprod_\alpha T_\alpha$, and, on each stratum, a pro-etale
covering $\{U_{\alpha j}\to T_\alpha\}_j$ with the following datum. For each
$U_{\alpha j}$ there is a bounded complex $L_{\alpha j}$, supported in
$[d_0,d_1]$, whose terms are finite locally constant $A_T|_{U_{\alpha
j}}$-modules and whose reductions have finite lisse cohomology, together with
isomorphisms

$$
 M_n|_{U_{\alpha j}}\xrightarrow{\sim}
 L_{\alpha j}\otimes^L_{A_T}(P_n)_T|_{U_{\alpha j}}
$$

for every $n$. These isomorphisms intertwine the normalization maps of
$M_\bullet$ with the quotient transition maps of the local reduction tower.
